title: One hide path: cells stage their saves first, then the page's single flush runs, so no cell calls the store's flush
evidence: From PR 1695 (Codex R1). HealthTool.tsx's visibilitychange and pagehide listener stages the page's waiting saves and calls flushRoadmapStoreSync (lib/roadmap-data.ts); it was registered before any saved-value editor opened, so it runs first. ValueCell (components/MatrixSavedCells.tsx, hide listener) stages its click-away save after that flush and so calls flushRoadmapStoreSync itself, an ordering patch. Wanted: one hide path in which every cell's staging runs before one flush, so listener order stops mattering and no cell reaches the store. (H92)
